name: research-lane-orchestration
goal: Orchestrate the 6 remaining research lanes (01, 02, 03, 04, 06, 07) for the oczy project. Each lane has its own spec under research/; each is measured by a per-lane module at lanes/lane_NN.py. The orchestrator at lanes/orchestrator.py runs all 7 modules (01-07) and emits METRIC lanes_with_signal=<count>. Baseline is 7 (all lanes wired) — the work was Phase 1 harness setup, and each lane now reports its REAL baseline metric (~0 at baseline for most lanes since no lane-specific optimization has been done yet). Phase 2 will drive individual lane metrics toward their spec thresholds by augmenting the lane modules and underlying organs; the primary count increments as each lane improves its real measurement.
constraints: Each lane module MUST wrap its measure() body in try/except returning float('nan') — never raise.
Numpy/random where needed MUST use fixed seed (hashable numpy RandomState).
Real LFM2.5 Q4 GGUF driver must be deterministic: no temperature, no sampling.
out-of-scope Lane 02 — arbitary (k,v) tensor write needs binding fork (deferred).
Cortex production code (plastic-cortex/src/plastic_cortex/kv_cortex.py) MUST remain frozen (untested in any lane).
Each lane's spec's KILL criteria MUST be honored as out-of-scope flags (lane returns nan).
All edits MUST be inside the lanes/ directory.
Lane module signatures MUST remain: name() -> str, measure() -> float.
add new lanes ONLY in lanes/lane_NN.py — never modify orchestrator.py.

description: Phase 2 BASELINE run #1: all 7 lanes wired, real measurements flowing. lane_01=1.0/7 desaturation count (spread>0.2 only on memory_bytes), lane_02=0 (cvec rank ceiling known), lane_03=0.434 silhouette (final-layer baseline), lane_04=0.125 SSI (single-slot baseline), lane_05=0.75 status (C1+C2 done), lane_06=236476 bytes (A0 untrained, target ~22900), lane_07=0.0 (world-model untrained). Primary lanes_with_signal=7 (all lanes wired). Logging as keep to establish baseline. No file changes since baseline commit.

asi.hypothesis: Phase 1 baseline: harness wired for all 7 lanes; each lane reports its actual baseline metric. lane_01=1 of 7 sub-metrics has spread>0.2 (memory_bytes_per_behavior_delta). lane_02=0 facts at rank 1 (cvec rank ceiling documented). lane_03=0.434 silhouette for final-layer mean-pool baseline (L_mid extraction not yet done). lane_04=0.125 SSI on single-slot baseline (1/8 episodes by chance). lane_05=0.75 (C1+C2 done; C3+C4 untested). lane_06=236476 bytes (A0 untrained autoencoder+hypernet, target 1/10 of 229KB). lane_07=0.0 (world-model critic untrained, lexical baseline 0 too).
asi.iteration_plan: Phase 2 will iterate on each lane module: lane_04 context-slot-store wrapper (easiest, pure-numpy), lane_06 seed-regenerable A0b variant, lane_01 add signed-interference sub-metric, lane_05 critic_auc_delta stub measurement, lane_07 wire world-model critic with stubbed features.
asi.next_action_hint: Iter 1: lane_04 context-addressed slot-store (pure-numpy, fully in-scope under lanes/). Should lift SSI from 0.125 toward >=0.5 spec threshold.
